decisions.statement: The plays taken are the fifty Spotify gives back for one page.
A run finding no play filed anywhere is a priming run.
A listen lands beside its day page and a heard track beside the heard music page.
Capture adds to the rows filed and rewrites no row already filed.
The plays are worked oldest first.
A play Spotify names no track id for is passed over and counted.
A track is heard again where either its id or its title key is already filed.
A track already heard keeps the instant that track was first heard.
The listens and the heard tracks land as a single commit or not at all.
A run recording nothing lands nothing.
A day with no page of its own is refused rather than given one.
A page is written through the change working out what kind of path it is.
The landing a page goes through is handed in.
A landing that wrote before it went wrong is answered with what that run wrote.
A run saying to write nothing reaches no landing and names what would be written.
Every listen and every heard track is composed carrying an id of its own.
No test here reaches Spotify.
An append hands in the body it read, so a body that moved refuses the write.
A day page written again hands in the body its values were composed from.
A run that wrote before it threw says in its refusal what that run had written.
A fault carries the code that fault names and says where it was thrown.

definition: the command filing what Alan played on Spotify onto the days he played it in
